sanskrit:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ।
सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ १०-७॥
iast:
etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
so’vikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ 10-7
translation: He, who in truth knows these manifold manifestations of My being (Macrocosm) , and (this) YOGA -power of Mine (Microcosm) , becomes established in the tremorless -YOGA  ; there is no doubt about it.
